name: copy_indexed_blocks_to_buffer
description: Copies a run of fixed-size blocks into a destination buffer, taking each block's source address from a pointer table selected by an index parameter and repeating for a count parameter. Afterwards it stores a constant word into a fixed field of the caller's structure.

name: find_flagged_masked_word
description: Searches up to a counter's worth of words for one whose companion word is nonzero and returns its value masked with a bit pattern. It returns the input value unchanged when the range check fails or the search finds nothing.

name: poll_flagged_masked_word
description: Scans words from a pointer, returning the first word masked with a bit pattern whose companion word is nonzero, and falls back to the input value when the counter runs out.

name: wait_masked_word_flag
description: Loops decrementing a counter until a companion word becomes nonzero, then returns the current word masked with a bit pattern; it returns the input value if the counter expires first.

name: unpack_checksummed_stream
description: Decodes a token stream into a buffer using literal bytes and back-references, verifying a running checksum against fixed constants. It returns the decoded length in the upper half of a 64-bit result only when the checksum matches, otherwise the original value.

name: unpack_budgeted_token_stream
description: Decodes token streams into a buffer, copying literal words or repeated runs and stopping when an output budget is exhausted. It finishes with the same checksum check as the decoder that precedes it.

name: unpack_reverse_copy_stream
description: Decodes a token stream into a buffer, handling copies that read backwards from an earlier source position as well as literal and repeated word runs. It ends with a checksum comparison that decides the return value.

name: unpack_word_run_stream
description: Decodes a token stream into a buffer, expanding repeated word-value runs and literal words under an output limit, and returns the count and checksum result in a 64-bit value.

name: unpack_byte_pair_stream
description: Decodes a token stream into a buffer, expanding repeated byte-pair runs, reversed copies and literals while tracking a remaining output budget. It stops at the end marker and returns a checksum-dependent value.

name: verify_stream_checksum
description: Sums words from a buffer against a fixed constant and returns the decoded length with the high half set when the final sum is zero, otherwise returns the input value.

name: pass_stack_argument_through
description: Returns the 32-bit value that the caller placed on the stack, without touching memory, registers or other routines.

name: install_interrupt_autovectors
description: Writes one handler address into the seven interrupt autovector slots, one per interrupt level from one to seven.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately; it is a stub with no body.

name: reset_keyboard_interrupt_state
description: After a short delay loop, clears the interrupt-pending bit in a shared state byte when it was not already set, then stores a fixed value in that byte. It is the keyboard interface step that reads and resets the keyboard serial register state.

name: select_interrupt_state_byte
description: Sets a shared state byte to one constant when bit five is clear. Otherwise it calls a helper routine and sets the byte to a second constant.

name: set_state_after_helper_call
description: Calls a helper routine, then stores a fixed constant into a shared state byte and returns a value built from a register and a stack word. The interrupt request register is touched through the helper path.

name: store_sum_as_split_words
description: Calls a helper routine three times, then adds two values and writes the sum into two word fields of a structure, low word first at one offset and high word at another.

name: store_split_long_fields
description: Writes the low and high words of an incoming register value into two word fields of the structure addressed by a base register.

name: write_display_setup_words
description: Stores six fixed display-setup words in sequence into a shared word and returns the last one, covering the display window, bitplane control and DMA enable values.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately; it is a stub with no body.

name: dispatch_boot_copy_request
description: Checks a magic value: on match it copies a fixed-length block into the global area, otherwise it clears one flag bit and, when another flag bit is set, copies a block of vector-sized longwords. The text path for the boot loader file is referenced here.

name: disable_interrupts_then_call_copy
description: Writes all-disable values to the interrupt and DMA control registers, copies a short block of longwords into low memory, and calls the copied code there.

name: copy_longs_then_jump_indirect
description: Copies a run of longwords from a source pointer into a fixed buffer and then transfers control to the address stored at the start of that buffer, which the decompiler could not resolve.

name: copy_longs_backward_then_jump
description: Copies longwords from the end of a source block toward the start into a fixed buffer, then transfers control indirectly to the address at the start of that buffer.

name: build_and_run_io_request
description: Fills in an I/O request block with a command, a length and a data pointer, submits it through the system DoIO call, and stores a fixed status value in the global state word.

description: Calls four helper routines in sequence and returns, with no visible effect on the global value.

name: store_constant_and_run_helpers
description: Stores a fixed word through a pointer, then calls three helper routines.

name: run_external_then_helpers
description: Calls an external routine at a fixed address, then calls three helper routines.

name: enter_infinite_loop
description: Loops forever with no operation, a dead end in the execution flow.

name: clear_ten_thousand_longs
description: Writes zero to ten thousand longwords starting at a fixed address.

name: clear_long_block_via_pointer
description: Writes zero to ten thousand longwords starting at a pointer stored in the caller's structure.

name: copy_long_block_to_pointer
description: Copies ten thousand longwords from a fixed address to a pointer stored in the caller's structure.

name: copy_long_block_to_pointer
description: Copies ten thousand longwords from a fixed address to a pointer stored in the caller's structure.

name: select_table_entry_with_wait
description: Waits for a flag to clear and calls a helper; when an index is below twelve, it reloads a table entry if it changed, calls a routine, and adds an offset to a global.

name: clear_state_then_call_helper
description: Clears a state global and then calls one helper routine.

name: return_helper_when_state_set
description: Returns zero unless a state value is nonzero, in which case it returns the result of a helper call.

name: reset_record_fields
description: Zeroes four word fields of a structure and sets another word field to fifteen.

name: clear_word_block_in_record
description: Zeroes twenty-four words starting at a fixed offset in a structure.

name: update_copper_state_and_helpers
description: Writes state constants, conditionally calls helper routines and touches the copper list pointer and vertical position register.

name: reset_display_state_and_helpers
description: Calls helpers and reads a table entry; when a flag is set it writes a set of constants into a state block, then branches on an index value.

name: wait_until_flag_cleared
description: Sets a flag, calls a helper, then spins until the flag is cleared.

name: pop_pending_input_code
description: Returns the next pending code from a small buffer, clearing it as it is read.

name: pop_pending_input_code
description: Alternate entry into the pending-code buffer logic that returns the next queued code, or zero when the buffer is empty.

name: poll_pending_input_code
description: Alternate entry into the pending-code buffer logic that checks a separate status byte before returning a queued code or zero.

name: pop_pending_input_code
description: Returns the next queued code from the pending buffer, or zero when nothing is queued, and resets the buffer state when it runs out.

name: start_pending_code_transfer
description: When a flag is set, copies a pointer and code into the buffer state, calls two routines and clears the flags; otherwise it marks the buffer as pending and returns.

name: reset_pending_code_mask
description: When a flag is zero, sets a mask value to 127, then clears another flag.

name: queue_masked_code
description: Stores the input code masked to 127 as the pending code, zeroes the buffer counters and calls a routine.

name: advance_pending_code_index
description: Clears a flag and, when the index is not twelve, increments it, zeroes the buffer counters and calls a routine.

name: clear_pending_code_and_call
description: Clears a counter and a field of the buffer state, then calls a routine.

name: start_five_step_transfer
description: Sets a transfer length to five, copies buffer fields, clears a flag and calls a routine.

name: clear_flags_and_advance_index
description: Clears transfer flags and, when a table index is not the last, advances the index and calls routines.

name: start_transfer_and_clear_flag
description: Sets buffer fields from the current index, calls two routines and clears a flag.

name: classify_countdown_range
description: Returns minus one, one or the input word depending on whether a countdown lies within two limits and a mode byte matches; otherwise it returns the input word unchanged.

name: build_masked_shift_table
description: Clears a global, then fills thirty-two words of an output table with a source table value ANDed with a mask shifted by a per-entry count.

name: clear_pending_record_slots
description: Walks twelve-byte records and, for each one with its flag set, clears the flag and zeroes the matching byte in a table, then returns the input word with bit zero set.

name: claim_free_slot_record
description: Finds a free slot by calling a helper for an index, and when that slot's flag is clear, fills in its identifier, data pointer and cleared counter fields.

name: claim_slot_when_requested
description: When a request flag is set, clears it and claims a free slot for the requested index.

name: count_active_slots_and_call
description: Optionally calls a routine for a table entry, then counts records with a nonzero field, calling a routine on each active one and storing the count.

name: dispatch_record_callback
description: When the record's delay counter is nonzero it decrements the counter and returns; otherwise it saves the record and calls the callback pointer stored in it.

name: copy_long_block_to_pointer
description: Copies ten thousand longwords from a fixed address to a pointer stored in the caller's structure.

name: read_table_word_pair
description: Selects a table word by a global index and returns its high byte together with its low byte XOR-ed with the global value.
